en: Decide when a manufacturing business commences
Find basis periods through two changes of accounting date
Compute qualifying building expenditure and IBA
Compute agriculture allowance, charge and the para 27 election
ms: Cari tempoh asas melalui dua pertukaran tarikh perakaunan
Hitung perbelanjaan bangunan layak dan IBA
Hitung elaun pertanian, caj dan pilihan para 27

blocks.en: The test paper REVISION_TEST.docx has four questions. Each section below gives the question as printed, then the answer. The paper comes without an answer key, so the answers are mine, from PR 11/2013, PR 8/2014, PR 3/2018 and PR 1/2016; check them with your lecturer. The same answers also sit in the Revision Test card of Chapters 1, 2 and 2B.
blocks.ms: Kertas ujian REVISION_TEST.docx ada empat soalan. Setiap bahagian di bawah memberi soalan seperti dicetak, kemudian jawapan. Kertas tiada kunci jawapan, jadi jawapan ini saya sediakan daripada PR 11/2013, PR 8/2014, PR 3/2018 dan PR 1/2016; semak dengan pensyarah. blocks.en: (a) Sugeh Sdn Bhd: when does trading commence?
blocks.ms: (a) Sugeh Sdn Bhd: bilakah perdagangan bermula?

blocks.en:
**Question**
Sugeh Sdn Bhd (SSB), a newly formed Malaysian tax resident company, closes accounts annually on 31 December. SSB acquired a piece of land to construct a factory building for the manufacture of refrigeration products. Relevant details are provided below:
18 February 2023: Date of incorporation
26 May 2023: Land acquired
11 August 2023: Agreement signed for construction of factory building
24 October 2024: Construction of factory building was completed and ready for use
1 December 2024: First batch of raw materials received
12 January 2025: First sale of products
blocks.ms:
**Soalan**
Sugeh Sdn Bhd (SSB), a newly formed Malaysian tax resident company, closes accounts annually on 31 December. SSB acquired a piece of land to construct a factory building for the manufacture of refrigeration products. Relevant details are provided below:
18 February 2023: Date of incorporation
26 May 2023: Land acquired
11 August 2023: Agreement signed for construction of factory building
24 October 2024: Construction of factory building was completed and ready for use
1 December 2024: First batch of raw materials received
12 January 2025: First sale of products

blocks.en:
**Required**
Explain when Sugeh Sdn Bhd will be regarded as having commenced trading.
blocks.ms:
**Diperlukan**
Explain when Sugeh Sdn Bhd will be regarded as having commenced trading.

en: Preparatory: the business has not yet begun its income-producing activity
ms: Persediaan: perniagaan belum memulakan aktiviti menjana pendapatan

en: Purchase of raw materials is the first act in the income-producing process of a manufacturer (PR 11/2013 para 5.2(a))
ms: Pembelian bahan mentah ialah tindakan pertama dalam proses menjana pendapatan pengeluar (PR 11/2013 para 5.2(a))

en: Sales are the result of trading, not its start
ms: Jualan ialah hasil perdagangan, bukan permulaan

blocks.en: Answer: SSB is regarded as having commenced trading on 1 December 2024. Commencement is the start of activities in the course of business, as distinct from preparatory activities (PR 11/2013 para 5.2); for manufacturing, the purchase of raw materials is the indicator. Consequences: the first basis period is 1.12.2024–31.12.2024 (under 12 months, same year), so YA2024 = 1.12.2024–31.12.2024 and YA2025 = 1.1.2025–31.12.2025; revenue expenses incurred before 1.12.2024 that qualify are deemed incurred on that day.
blocks.ms: Jawapan: SSB dianggap memulakan perdagangan pada 1 Disember 2024. Permulaan ialah mula aktiviti dalam perjalanan perniagaan, berbeza daripada aktiviti persediaan (PR 11/2013 para 5.2); bagi pembuatan, pembelian bahan mentah ialah petunjuknya. Akibatnya: tempoh asas pertama 1.12.2024–31.12.2024 (kurang 12 bulan, tahun sama), jadi YA2024 = 1.12.2024–31.12.2024 dan YA2025 = 1.1.2025–31.12.2025; perbelanjaan hasil sebelum 1.12.2024 yang layak dianggap ditanggung pada hari itu.

blocks.en: Your slide 7 (Chapter 1) says manufacturing starts when plant and machinery are in place and stock has arrived. Both give 1.12.2024 here, if the machinery was already installed.
blocks.ms: Slaid 7 anda (Bab 1) menyatakan pembuatan bermula apabila loji dan jentera sedia dan stok tiba. Kedua-duanya memberi 1.12.2024 di sini, jika jentera sudah dipasang.

blocks.en: (b) Lazat Sdn Bhd: basis periods
blocks.ms: (b) Lazat Sdn Bhd: tempoh asas

blocks.en:
**Question**
Lazat Sdn. Bhd. commenced business on 1 July 2020 and prepare its first set of accounts to 31 March 2021. The company decided to change its accounting period to end on 31 December annually. Later, after the appointment of the new Chairman and Board of Directors in 2024, the company again change its accounting period to 31 October annually. The following information pertaining to the accounting periods:
Year of assessment 2021: 1/7/2020 – 31/3/2021
Year of assessment 2022: 1/4/2021 – 31/3/2022
Year of assessment 2022: 1/4/2022 – 31/12/2022
Year of assessment 2023: 1/1/2023 – 31/12/2023
Year of assessment 2025: 1/1/2024 – 31/10/2025
blocks.ms:
**Soalan**
Lazat Sdn. Bhd. commenced business on 1 July 2020 and prepare its first set of accounts to 31 March 2021. The company decided to change its accounting period to end on 31 December annually. Later, after the appointment of the new Chairman and Board of Directors in 2024, the company again change its accounting period to 31 October annually. The following information pertaining to the accounting periods:
Year of assessment 2021: 1/7/2020 – 31/3/2021
Year of assessment 2022: 1/4/2021 – 31/3/2022
Year of assessment 2022: 1/4/2022 – 31/12/2022
Year of assessment 2023: 1/1/2023 – 31/12/2023
Year of assessment 2025: 1/1/2024 – 31/10/2025

blocks.en:
**Required**
Determine the basis period for all the relevant years of assessment until year of assessment 2025.
blocks.ms:
**Diperlukan**
Determine the basis period for all the relevant years of assessment until year of assessment 2025.

blocks.en: Glory Sdn Bhd (YA2025): qualifying expenditure and IBA
blocks.ms: Glory Sdn Bhd (YA2025): perbelanjaan layak dan IBA

blocks.en:
**Question**
Glory Sdn Bhd (GSB), a Malaysian tax resident manufacturing company, constructed its second factory building and a warehouse, as part of its expansion plans during the year of assessment 2025. GSB closes its accounts annually on 31 December. Details of the costs incurred in relation to the buildings which were completed and put into business use by GSB during the year, are as follows:
Land: RM560,000
Stamp duty on land acquired: RM10,000
Demolition of an existing car showroom building on the land: RM410,000
Cost of construction of the factory building: RM6,300,000
Cost of construction of the warehouse within the company’s curtilage: RM360,000 (Note: The warehouse is 20% of the total area constructed)
blocks.ms:
**Soalan**
Glory Sdn Bhd (GSB), a Malaysian tax resident manufacturing company, constructed its second factory building and a warehouse, as part of its expansion plans during the year of assessment 2025. GSB closes its accounts annually on 31 December. Details of the costs incurred in relation to the buildings which were completed and put into business use by GSB during the year, are as follows:
Land: RM560,000
Stamp duty on land acquired: RM10,000
Demolition of an existing car showroom building on the land: RM410,000
Cost of construction of the factory building: RM6,300,000
Cost of construction of the warehouse within the company’s curtilage: RM360,000 (Note: The warehouse is 20% of the total area constructed)

blocks.en:
**Required**
Determine the qualifying expenditure for industrial building purpose, and calculate the industrial building allowances which GSB may claim for the year of assessment 2025. (7 marks)
blocks.ms:
**Diperlukan**
Determine the qualifying expenditure for industrial building purpose, and calculate the industrial building allowances which GSB may claim for the year of assessment 2025. (7 marks)

en: Cost of land never qualifies (PR 3/2018 para 4.1 note)
ms: Kos tanah tidak pernah layak (PR 3/2018 para 4.1.1 nota)

en: Cost of acquiring title to the site

Clearing the old site qualifies when the old structure was not an industrial building (a showroom is not) and the new building is on the same site (para 4.1(d)); same site is assumed. The cost goes with the factory, the building put up on the cleared site
ms: Pembersihan tapak lama layak jika struktur lama bukan bangunan industri (bilik pameran bukan) dan bangunan baharu di tapak sama (para 4.1(d)); tapak sama diandaikan. Kos ini bersama kilang, bangunan yang didirikan di tapak yang dibersihkan

en: A building in the factory’s own compound used to store its goods is an industrial building. The 10% rule applies only to a part not used as an industrial building, so the 20% floor area does not reduce the cost
ms: Bangunan dalam kawasan kilang sendiri untuk menyimpan barangannya ialah bangunan industri. Peraturan 10% hanya untuk bahagian yang tidak digunakan sebagai bangunan industri, jadi 20% luas lantai tidak mengurangkan kos

blocks.en: Assumptions: both buildings were put into use in the basis period, so IA and AA are both given in YA2025 (AA is a full 3%, not time-apportioned), and the rates are IA 10% and AA 3% as in your lecturer’s sheet. If the warehouse were not for the company’s own goods (for example, for hire to the public), it would need the separate warehouse rules.
blocks.ms: Andaian: kedua-dua bangunan digunakan dalam tempoh asas, jadi IA dan AA diberi dalam YA2025 (AA penuh 3%, tidak dibahagi masa), dan kadar IA 10% serta AA 3% seperti lembaran pensyarah. Jika gudang bukan untuk barangan syarikat sendiri (contohnya disewakan kepada orang awam), peraturan gudang berasingan terpakai.

title.en: Q4: Choco Farm, agriculture allowance (7 marks)
title.ms: Q4: Choco Farm, elaun pertanian (7 markah)

blocks.en: Choco Farm: estate office RM120,000
blocks.ms: Choco Farm: pejabat estet RM120,000

blocks.en:
**Question**
Choco Farm Sdn. Bhd. operates an agriculture business producing cocoa and makes up its accounts to 31 December each year. In June 2024, Choco Farm constructed an estate office building for RM120,000 and it was used during the basis period for the year of assessment 2024. On 31 March 2026, Choco Farm disposed of the estate office to Sweet Farm Sdn. Bhd. for RM88,000.
blocks.ms:
**Soalan**
Choco Farm Sdn. Bhd. operates an agriculture business producing cocoa and makes up its accounts to 31 December each year. In June 2024, Choco Farm constructed an estate office building for RM120,000 and it was used during the basis period for the year of assessment 2024. On 31 March 2026, Choco Farm disposed of the estate office to Sweet Farm Sdn. Bhd. for RM88,000.

blocks.en:
**Required**
Compute the agriculture allowances / charges claimable in respect of the estate office in each of the years of assessment 2024 to 2027 by both Choco Farm Sdn. Bhd. and Tawau Farm Sdn. Bhd., assuming Choco Farm:
(i) made an election under Paragraph 27 of the Income Tax Act 1967.
(ii) made no election under Paragraph 27 of the Income Tax Act 1967.
(7 marks)
blocks.ms:
**Diperlukan**
Compute the agriculture allowances / charges claimable in respect of the estate office in each of the years of assessment 2024 to 2027 by both Choco Farm Sdn. Bhd. and Tawau Farm Sdn. Bhd., assuming Choco Farm:
(i) made an election under Paragraph 27 of the Income Tax Act 1967.
(ii) made no election under Paragraph 27 of the Income Tax Act 1967.
(7 marks)

blocks.en: The estate office is a farm building: 10% × 120,000 = RM12,000 a year, starting YA2024 (used in the basis period, year end 31 December). It was sold on 31.3.2026, within 5 years of the expenditure, so a charge arises on Choco equal to all the allowances given; the RM88,000 price is ignored. The YA2026 allowance is time-apportioned to the date of disposal, counting the disposal day: 1 Jan to 31 Mar 2026 = 90 days, so 90/365 × 12,000 = RM2,958.90.
blocks.ms: Pejabat estet ialah bangunan ladang: 10% × 120,000 = RM12,000 setahun, bermula YA2024 (digunakan dalam tempoh asas, akhir tahun 31 Disember). Ia dijual pada 31.3.2026, dalam 5 tahun daripada perbelanjaan, maka caj timbul ke atas Choco sama dengan semua elaun diberi; harga RM88,000 diabaikan. Elaun YA2026 dibahagi masa hingga tarikh pelupusan, termasuk hari pelupusan: 1 Jan hingga 31 Mac 2026 = 90 hari, jadi 90/365 × 12,000 = RM2,958.90.

blocks.en: (i) With the para 27 election: Choco Farm
blocks.ms: (i) Dengan pilihan para 27: Choco Farm

blocks.en: (ii) With no election: Choco Farm
blocks.ms: (ii) Tanpa pilihan: Choco Farm

blocks.en: Sweet Farm (the buyer): same in both cases
blocks.ms: Sweet Farm (pembeli): sama dalam kedua-dua kes

en: 12,000 − 2,958.90: the rest of the year’s allowance, if the buyer’s basis period also falls in YA2026 (PR 1/2016 para 7.2)
ms: 12,000 − 2,958.90: baki elaun tahun itu, jika tempoh asas pembeli juga dalam YA2026 (PR 1/2016 para 7.2)

en: A full year of 10% of the original cost

blocks.en: The election only moves the charge between years; the buyer’s allowance does not change, and the buyer’s allowances continue each year until the 10-year life is used. Assumption: Sweet Farm’s year end is also 31 December (any year end from 31.3.2026 to 30.3.2027 puts the purchase in YA2026 as well). The election is made by the seller; the buyer is not affected.
blocks.ms: Pilihan hanya memindahkan caj antara tahun; elaun pembeli tidak berubah, dan elaun pembeli berterusan setiap tahun sehingga hayat 10 tahun habis. Andaian: akhir tahun Sweet Farm juga 31 Disember (sebarang akhir tahun dari 31.3.2026 hingga 30.3.2027 meletakkan pembelian dalam YA2026 juga). Pilihan dibuat oleh penjual; pembeli tidak terjejas.

q.en: When does a manufacturer commence trading (Sugeh)?

a.en: When it starts activity in the income-producing process: the purchase of raw materials, 1.12.2024. Incorporation, land, construction and a ready factory are preparatory; the first sale is later.
a.ms: Apabila ia memulakan aktiviti dalam proses menjana pendapatan: pembelian bahan mentah, 1.12.2024. Penubuhan, tanah, pembinaan dan kilang siap ialah persediaan; jualan pertama terlewat.

a.en: The 9-month period to 31.12.2022 closes in YA2022, the same YA as the 31.3.2022 accounts, so it is combined with the 2023 accounts. YA2022 stays 1.4.2021–31.3.2022 (lecturer’s answer).
a.ms: Tempoh 9 bulan hingga 31.12.2022 ditutup dalam YA2022, YA sama dengan akaun 31.3.2022, jadi digabung dengan akaun 2023. YA2022 kekal 1.4.2021–31.3.2022 (jawapan pensyarah).

q.en: Lazat: how is the 22-month period 1.1.2024–31.10.2025 split?

a.en: It ends in the third year from the last normal year, so it is divided in two: YA2024 = 1.1.2024–30.11.2024 and YA2025 = 1.12.2024–31.10.2025 (11 months each).
a.ms: Ia berakhir pada tahun ketiga daripada tahun biasa terakhir, jadi dibahagi dua: YA2024 = 1.1.2024–30.11.2024 dan YA2025 = 1.12.2024–31.10.2025 (11 bulan setiap satu).

q.en: Glory: which items form the QBE?

a.en: Factory 6,710,000 (demolition 410,000 + construction 6,300,000) and warehouse 360,000 = RM7,070,000. Land and stamp duty are excluded. Factory: IA 671,000 + AA 201,300 = 872,300. Warehouse: IA 36,000 + AA 10,800 = 46,800. Total RM919,100.
a.ms: Kilang 6,710,000 (roboh 410,000 + pembinaan 6,300,000) dan gudang 360,000 = RM7,070,000. Tanah dan duti setem dikecualikan. Kilang: IA 671,000 + AA 201,300 = 872,300. Gudang: IA 36,000 + AA 10,800 = 46,800. Jumlah RM919,100.

q.en: Choco Farm: how is the charge worked out?

a.en: 10% × 120,000 = 12,000 a year. Charge = 12,000 + 12,000 + 90/365 × 12,000 (2,958.90) = RM26,958.90; the price is ignored. With the para 27 election, 8,986.30 in each of YA2024 to YA2026.
a.ms: 10% × 120,000 = 12,000 setahun. Caj = 12,000 + 12,000 + 90/365 × 12,000 (2,958.90) = RM26,958.90; harga diabaikan. Dengan pilihan para 27, 8,986.30 dalam setiap YA2024 hingga YA2026.

q.en: Sugeh Sdn Bhd, a manufacturer, received its first raw materials on 1.12.2024 and made its first sale on 12.1.2025. When did it commence trading?
q.ms: Sugeh Sdn Bhd, pengeluar, menerima bahan mentah pertama pada 1.12.2024 dan membuat jualan pertama pada 12.1.2025. Bilakah ia memulakan perdagangan?

o: 1.12.2024, when raw materials were first received
12.1.2025, when the first sale was made

e.en: Commencement is the start of the income-producing process; for manufacturing, the purchase of raw materials (PR 11/2013 para 5.2).
e.ms: Permulaan ialah mula proses menjana pendapatan; bagi pembuatan, pembelian bahan mentah (PR 11/2013 para 5.2).

q.en: Lazat Sdn Bhd (normal year end 31 December) changed to a 22-month period 1.1.2024–31.10.2025. What is the basis period for YA2024?
q.ms: Lazat Sdn Bhd (akhir tahun biasa 31 Disember) bertukar kepada tempoh 22 bulan 1.1.2024–31.10.2025. Apakah tempoh asas YA2024?

e.en: A period of more than 12 months ending in the third year is divided into two: 11 months each, so YA2024 = 1.1.2024–30.11.2024.
e.ms: Tempoh lebih 12 bulan yang berakhir pada tahun ketiga dibahagi dua: 11 bulan setiap satu, jadi YA2024 = 1.1.2024–30.11.2024.

q.en: Glory: land 560,000, stamp duty 10,000, demolition of a car showroom 410,000, factory 6,300,000, warehouse in the same compound 360,000. What is the QBE?
q.ms: Glory: tanah 560,000, duti setem 10,000, roboh bilik pameran kereta 410,000, kilang 6,300,000, gudang dalam kawasan sama 360,000. Berapakah PBL?

e.en: Land and stamp duty are out; demolition qualifies because a showroom is not an industrial building; the warehouse in the curtilage is an industrial building. 410,000 + 6,300,000 + 360,000.
e.ms: Tanah dan duti setem tidak layak; roboh layak kerana bilik pameran bukan bangunan industri; gudang dalam curtilage ialah bangunan industri. 410,000 + 6,300,000 + 360,000.

q.en: Choco Farm sold an estate office (cost 120,000, used from YA2024) on 31.3.2026 for 88,000, with no para 27 election. What is the charge?
q.ms: Choco Farm menjual pejabat estet (kos 120,000, digunakan dari YA2024) pada 31.3.2026 dengan harga 88,000, tanpa pilihan para 27. Berapakah caj?

e.en: Charge = all allowances given: 12,000 + 12,000 + 90/365 × 12,000 = 26,958.90. The price is ignored.
e.ms: Caj = semua elaun diberi: 12,000 + 12,000 + 90/365 × 12,000 = 26,958.90. Harga diabaikan.

q.en: Determine the qualifying expenditure for industrial building purpose, and calculate the industrial building allowances which GSB may claim for YA2025 (Glory Sdn Bhd).
q.ms: Tentukan perbelanjaan layak bagi tujuan bangunan industri, dan hitung elaun bangunan industri yang boleh dituntut GSB bagi YA2025 (Glory Sdn Bhd).

en: Demolition 410,000 qualifies: old showroom was not an industrial building (1)
Warehouse in the curtilage is an industrial building; the 10% rule is not triggered (1)
Factory IA 671,000 + AA 201,300; warehouse IA 36,000 + AA 10,800; total RM919,100 (2)
ms: Roboh 410,000 layak: bilik pameran lama bukan bangunan industri (1)
Gudang dalam curtilage ialah bangunan industri; peraturan 10% tidak terpakai (1)
Kilang IA 671,000 + AA 201,300; gudang IA 36,000 + AA 10,800; jumlah RM919,100 (2)

q.en: Compute the agriculture allowances and charges on the estate office for YA2024 to YA2027 for Choco Farm and the buyer, with and without the para 27 election.
q.ms: Hitung elaun dan caj pertanian bagi pejabat estet untuk YA2024 hingga YA2027 bagi Choco Farm dan pembeli, dengan dan tanpa pilihan para 27.

en: Rate 10%, allowance 12,000 a year from YA2024 (1)
Sold within 5 years, so a charge equal to all allowances given (1)
Election: 8,986.30 in each of YA2024 to YA2026 (1)
Net amount for each YA, with and without election (1)
ms: Dijual dalam 5 tahun, jadi caj sama dengan semua elaun diberi (1)
Pilihan: 8,986.30 dalam setiap YA2024 hingga YA2026 (1)
Jumlah bersih setiap YA, dengan dan tanpa pilihan (1)
Pembeli: 9,041.10 dalam YA2026 dan 12,000 dalam YA2027 (1)
